p0_findings.finding: The quarantine path is not prevalidated absent, mv failure is swallowed with || true, and no canonical-absent/quarantine-present postcondition is checked. A postverify failure can leave canonical RUN_COMPLETE in place while the trap claims quarantine success.
p0_findings.minimal_fix: Precompute a unique absent quarantine path before installing the trap; do not silently swallow rename failure; assert canonical absent and a non-symlink quarantine directory present before reporting success.

p1_findings.finding: Waiting only covers an already-running exact watcher tag and has no timeout or periodic state receipt.
A noncooperating launch can race after the second query, and raw GPU identity is not enforced as exact one-A800 UUID/model/driver/index0.
Major import roots and dangerous environment variables are handled, but repo-root shadows and DSEC sample-content identity remain incomplete.
Before final publication, attempt/result failures or signals leave ambiguous non-rerunnable artifacts without FAILED_DO_NOT_CITE or partial quarantine.
Final semantics do not re-cross-check all factor receipt artifact hashes and only type-check the propagated M513 identity.
Published population counts files only, so new directory entries are ignored; completion text and JSON schema/status/claim boundaries are not semantically rechecked.
HUP/INT/TERM reuse local rc=$? rather than explicit 129/130/143 and may therefore exit zero despite interruption.
The persisted END SHA is sampled before final staging, sealing, publication and postverification; no true-end fourth sample is recorded.

decision.reason: The preverified atomic-publish chain is now sound, but its ordinary-failure quarantine can silently fail and leave a canonical PASS package. P0 must be zero before launch.
